excerpts.content:
if you have a curve I can help you bench.

In summary:
- if vartime, Jacobian are always faster than projective.
- if constant-time and the equations is of the form y² = x³ + b, then projective is likely faster than Jacobian (this is the case for all secp256k1, BN254 and BLS12-381)
